pages.title: Holographic Encoder
pages.text: The $(item)Holographic Encoder$() writes a volume of matter onto its own boundary surface, per the holographic principle.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.

Day 61. The holographic principle: the most information a region can hold grows with its surface area, not its volume - a black hole's entropy is a quarter of its horizon area in Planck units. So a volume can, in principle, be written onto its own boundary. This machine does exactly that.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Bekenstein Crystal, Boundary CFT Chip, Contagion Network Map, Holographic Matrix, Holographic Screen.
